content.summary: 'The Value of Work' is organised around source-supported concepts, evidence and applications.
key_points: 13 CHAPTER The Value of Work When you are doing any work, do not think of anything beyond.
Do it as worship, as the highest worship, and devote your whole life to it for the time being.
What are the different types of The Big activities that people engage in?
Anu and Kabir were playing in the park when they saw their neighbour, Geeta Aunty, getting out of a taxi.
She was returning home from work and was in her uniform.
A pilot in the Indian Air Force, she is the pride of the whole town.
